intent: Immutable value record of one 1Hz sample. t_device (tDeviceEpochMs) is the chronological key, t_ingress is informational only. Constants VALID="VALID", VALIDATION_FAILED="VALIDATION_FAILED". Compact constructor rejects blank deviceId/metric and null status. Shared by Ingestion, Reordering and Event Log. No framework imports.

methods.signature: public record TelemetrySample(String deviceId, String metric, long tDeviceEpochMs, double value, long tIngressEpochMs, String validationStatus)
